8 Days / 7 Nights

Uttarakhand : Backpacking Odyssey

Delhi — Joshimath — Auli — Chopta — Tungnath — Deoria Tal — Rishikesh — Delhi

About This Trip

Forget the typical tourist trails. We’re taking you deep into the Garhwal Himalayas for an experience that spans from 1,120 ft to 13,123 ft. At Awara Banjara, we believe Uttarakhand is best explored on foot and in good company. Whether we're summiting the world’s highest Shiva temple at Tungnath, catching the sunrise over Nanda Devi from the Auli meadows, or cliff-jumping into the emerald waters of the Ganges, this trip is about pushing your limits and finding your tribe.

Itinerary

Pick up at Botanical Garden Metro Station at 8:30 PM. Briefing by Trip Captain and overnight journey.

Scenic drive along Badrinath road viewing Ganga's confluences. Check-in and evening leisure walk in Joshimath.

Early morning trip to Auli. Experience the chair car ride and explore snow-clad peaks of Nanda Devi.

Drive to Chopta, check into campsites, unwind with nature and enjoy evening snacks.

4km trek to World's Highest Shiva Temple (12,106 ft) and Chandrashila Summit (12,110 ft).

Trek to pristine Deoria Tal lake via Sari Village, then drive to Rishikesh by evening.

Exciting river rafting on Ganga, visit Ram Jhula & Janki Setu, experience Ganga Aarti, then overnight drive to Delhi.

Return to Delhi in the early morning. Tour ends with fond memories.
